name: Hurricane, Stuka and D.520 Flyables (Cuesta brothers)
summary: Flyable Hurricane, Ju 87 Stuka and Dewoitine D.520 that use the P-51D cockpit and avionics.
description:
Three flyable 1940 aircraft (Hawker Hurricane, Ju 87 Stuka, Dewoitine D.520) that reuse the P-51D cockpit and avionics. Install them one at a time with JSGME. Built for DCS 2.8.1 (also said to work with 2.7).

Requires: Requires the paid P-51D module (the TF-51D does not work, per the authors). Use only one flyable at a time via JSGME.
